correctness.rationale: Exact Laplace integration gives a quartic polynomial on Re z=2. Expanded positive Hurwitz minors rigorously exclude all delay-frequency zeros for 0<=d<d*, and for d=d* except the exact zero-delay pair; continuity of the maximum real part of the quartic roots proves existence above d*. The critical roots and symbolic determinant coefficients replayed from checker.py, supplemented by direct numerical quadrature. The proof covers every real delay and frequency with no finite-enumeration inference.

value.rationale: Determines the exact global boundary between zero-free and zero-bearing self-ambiguity for a natural strictly positive causal pulse family with continuously tunable admixture of two canonical exponential moments. The sharp constant, critical zero-delay pair and forced nonzero-delay zeros quantify a bifurcation. It also supplies a structural nonclosure example: the two endpoint windows have zero-free ambiguity but some positive combinations do not. The result is not merely a numerical instance or a routine alias of existing pure-moment theorems.
